audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 gave the stage to Ornn in both layers while their whys read 'stays even as the lane is a farm fest with no early kill pressure either way' and 'still skill-based'.
audit.why: Ornn at levels 2-3 has one 9s fissure and no way to punish a melee who does not stand next to the pillar. The packet chart reads Skill through row 4 and the mirror audit already set rows 1 and 2 to Skill.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 set to Skill in both layers as matched pairs. Rows 5 and 6 stay Ornn.

audit.whatIsWrong: Call of the Forge God was described as 'engage from range and reactivate to knock you up' with no cooldown and no mention of the Brittle it applies.
audit.why: It is 140s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in the lane and therefore the most punishable window — and Riot's text says enemies run over by the elemental are slowed and made Brittle, which is what makes the follow-up land.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten with the 140s cooldown, the Brittle application and the recast redirect, plus concrete E-holding advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most decisive interaction was never stated: Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar is the terrain Searing Charge needs to collide with in order to knock up. The page told the reader to 'dodge his Q knockup' — the Q has no knockup at all. 'E Golden Onslaught' also is not one of Zaahen's abilities.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q leaves a magma pillar; E only creates the shockwave and knockup 'if Ornn collides with terrain while charging'. So the actual rule is positional — never stand between Ornn and his own pillar (or a lane wall) — and that rule appeared nowhere. Bellows Breath is the Brittle applier, on its final gout of flame, 12s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Pillar-into-charge interaction written into spikes[0], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t; Bellows Breath's final-gout Brittle stated in early and mid with its 12s cooldown; fabricated E name replaced with a slot reference.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns tracked only 'Volcanic Rupture' with no number.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Bellows Breath 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 at 450 range, Call of the Forge God 140/120/100.
audit.corrected: All four written into breakdown.cooldowns, spikes and mid.

edits.before: Ornn is a scaling tank who wants to farm safely with Brittle procs off his abilities; the early lane is a skill-based farm fest where you space around Q Darkin Glaive and punish him only when he over-uses W Bellows Breath to shove.
edits.after: Ornn is a scaling tank who farms safely and sets up Brittle; the early lane is a skill-based farm fest. Volcanic Rupture (Q) is 9s and leaves a magma pillar — the terrain Searing Charge (E) rams into for its knockup. Never stand between him and it.

edits.before: Ornn R Call of the Forge God lets him engage from range and reactivate to knock you up, so his pick and skirmish threat rises; hold E Golden Onslaught and don't get caught in a wall-into-ram Brittle combo.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God (R) is 140s at rank 1: the elemental runs you over, slows you and makes you Brittle, and he can recast to charge into it and redirect it. Hold your E for after the elemental passes, not before.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are an even, farm-focused start; Ornn just wants to CS and stack Brittle procs, so space with Q Darkin Glaive and don't walk into his W Bellows Breath. Neither side has a real kill threat this early.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are an even, farm-focused start; Ornn just wants to CS, so space with your Q and stay out of the final gout of Bellows Breath — that last tick is the part that makes you Brittle. Neither side has a real kill threat yet.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay skill-based and even: Ornn is happy to farm and scale, and your job is to tax him when he over-commits W to shove or misplaces his Brittle setup. His R Call of the Forge God at 6 adds pick threat but doesn't flip the lane on its own.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay skill-based and even: Ornn is happy to farm and scale, and your job is to tax him when he over-commits Bellows Breath to shove — it is 12s at rank 1 and it is what applies Brittle. His R at 6 adds pick threat but does not flip the lane on its own.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Volcanic Rupture (Q): matchup-defining — 9s at rank 1, and its magma pillar is terrain. - Searing Charge (E): 14s, 450 range, and it only knocks up off terrain. - Bellows Breath (W): 12s, applies Brittle.

edits.before: Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 9s at rank 1, and its magma pillar is the wall his E knockup needs.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The final gout of Bellows Breath is the part that applies it.

edits.before: Track Ornn's Volcanic Rupture: Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. When it is down — Combo + R him.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture's pillar is terrain — it is what Searing Charge rams into to knock you up.

notes: dosFull[1].t still reads 'Dodge his Q knockup'. Volcanic Rupture has no knockup — the knockup is Searing Charge colliding with terrain. The title is 19 characters, well under the applier's 25-character skip threshold, so I could not propose it as an edit; it needs a hand fix to something like 'Dodge his Q pillar'. Same for report[11].t, which repeats 'Stand near walls for his Q' as a common mistake — that phrasing is accidentally correct (walls do enable the charge knockup) so I left it. Zaahen's E is written by effect rather than a name, since champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json carries none.
